name: Peter Hujar / Liz Deschenes: Persistence of Vision
description: The Gropius Bau celebrates the opening of Peter Hujar / Liz Deschenes: Persistence of Vision, marking the start of the 2026 exhibition program. This groundbreaking exhibition brings together the work of two photographers across generations, exploring themes of visibility, memory, and the medium of photography itself. The opening evening offers free admission and features a DJ set providing musical accompaniment. This is a rare opportunity to see Peter Hujar's iconic black-and-white portraits alongside Liz Deschenes' experimental photographic work in one of Berlin's most prestigious contemporary art venues.
